-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`apply` expects a function that performs no effects, but this one performs `Console`.

4| main() = print (apply { n -> print n; n + 1 } 1)
                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

To accept effects, make `apply` generic over them: give this parameter's arrow a
row variable, as in `->{e}`, and add `{e}` to the final arrow of `apply`.
